glosses: turn (chance to use (something) shared in sequence with others)
turn (chance to make a move in a game)
shift (set group of workers or period of working time)

examples.text: Bebían de la fuente por turnos.
examples.en: They took turns drinking from the water fountain.

examples.text: Tom y Mary tomaron turnos de guardia.
examples.en: Tom and Mary took turns standing guard.
